standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies proving the isomorphism c' on stalks.

core_obligations: Construct c(s) for a formal sum s = sum (Z_i, s_i) in f_{p!}F(V) by viewing the same sum as an element of f'_{p!}F(V') with V' = Y' x_Y V, using that Z_i stays locally closed in X_{V'} and is finite over V' because g is separated (proof lines 1652-1665); check compatibility with the relations and restrictions (proof lines 1663-1665).
Show the image of c^# lies in the subsheaf g_! f'_! F using properness over V of the image of the disjoint union of the Z_i, giving the factor map c': f_! F -> g_! f'_! F (proof lines 1667-1677).

Prove compatibility (a) with open-embedding covariance via the three-level diagram, the routine middle-row commutativity check, and the section-wise verification on pullbacks of formal sums (proof lines 1679-1788).

Prove compatibility (b) with the two base change isomorphisms through the same diagram (proof lines 1748-1788), record the author's omission of the detail comparison for (c) (proof lines 1791-1792), and prove c' is an isomorphism: stalk reduction to Y = Spec(k) via (b), the H^0 identifications from the two stalk lemmas, decomposition of X into Artinian local spectra, direct-sum reduction to skyscraper sheaves, and the identity check on skyscrapers (proof lines 1795-1824).
proof_roadmap: Build the presheaf map c across the base change and land its sheafification in g_! f'_! F (proof lines 1643-1677).
Verify covariance (a) and base change compatibility (b) via the base-changed diagram (proof lines 1679-1788).
Conclude c' is an isomorphism by stalk reduction to the skyscraper case over a field (proof lines 1795-1824).
